title: Draft V2 requirements and overall design
goal: Create a proposed V2 requirements specification, change package, and overall architecture for the superconducting quantum-computing control group workflow without finalizing detailed design before human approval
out_of_scope: Detailed design finalization before human overall-design approval
Product code, database migration implementation, AI, mobile, authentication, deployment
acceptance_criteria: V2 requirements capture source groups, lightweight control plans, human assignment, configurable arrival-window overview, equipment changes, deliverable submission, and manual acceptance
Overall design preserves V1 operation and clearly defines proposed additive data, API, desktop information architecture, migration safety, and approval gates
Documents remain proposed/draft under BL-002 until explicit human overall-design approval

release_controls.rollback_plan: revert the local V2 design documentation commit before baseline approval
release_controls.observation_metrics: document registry consistency, requirement traceability, architecture completeness, review findings, and Release governance results
release_controls.stop_conditions: scope ambiguity, detailed-design gate violation, active baseline mutation, or unresolved reviewer finding
